body:
Cinnabar in tumbled form is incredibly rare—and this batch is no exception. Sourced from a single specialized vendor at the Tucson Gem Show, these stones are part of a limited production that few ever get access to. We handpicked each one early, selecting for both quality and energetic intensity.

Known as a powerful stone of wealth and success, Cinnabar carries a bold, activating energy that supports manifestation on a tangible level. It amplifies your ability to take action, recognize opportunity, and move confidently toward your goals.

This is not a passive stone. Cinnabar works with your root and sacral energy centers to build momentum, confidence, and drive. It encourages leadership, decision-making, and the courage to pursue what you truly want.

For those ready to expand financially, energetically, or personally, Cinnabar acts as a catalyst—aligning your energy with results.

Rare and highly sought after, this is a stone for serious manifestation.
